findings.motion: M11 Concur (House concurrence in the Senate committee substitute), Roll Call #801, passed 62-47
findings.note: The roll call transcript lists Zenger among the Ayes on House concurrence in HB 958, Election Law Changes. The ratified bill (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) says a county board processes a voter registration application only if it affirmatively indicates the applicant is a United States citizen, with a 30-day notice and a statement under penalty of perjury if the answer is blank. It also requires a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. The bill page shows the Governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17.
